text: [82] sattannaṃ bhikkhave dhammānaṃ bhinnattā bhikkhu hoti . katamesaṃ sattannaṃ sakkāyadiṭṭhi bhinnā hoti vicikicchā bhinnā hoti sīlabbataparāmāso bhinno hoti rāgo bhinno hoti doso bhinno hoti moho bhinno hoti māno bhinno hoti . imesaṃ kho bhikkhave sattannaṃ dhammānaṃ bhinnattā bhikkhu hotīti .
